prompt: Using the first image as the place and the second image as the woman, make a new frame in the same tunnel. A mid close-up of the woman from the second image (same face, hair tied back, cream cable-knit jumper), standing among the crowd of survivors in the whitewashed brick vault, half-turned towards someone just out of frame, mid-sentence, wry and tired. Behind her, high on the curved wall, the cream loudspeaker horn hangs tilted downwards on its bent bracket after a blast, a little dust still drifting in the air. The only light is the small bare bulb on the wall beside the horn, warm, from one side; faces in the crowd behind her soft in shadow. 1980s BBC 16mm documentary look: faded colour, soft contrast, heavy grain.
